# A short markdown note

Alexandria is a local knowledge store. It ingests documents and dedupes them by
content hash. The goal is to keep both research papers and household bills in one
searchable index while preventing duplicate ingestion of the same underlying content.

## Test paragraph two

Some more text to make chunking meaningful. Retrieval-augmented generation, vector
databases, and BM25 keyword search all live under one roof here. The MCP interface
comes in a later milestone.
